messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish the existing Sunday Showdown football card game as a complete, playable game.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Continue with the existing card-game implementation and address gameplay flow issues in `card-game.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a drive counter to new game state and wired it to the scoreboard.
- Incremented the drive counter when possession changes.
- Ensured the third-quarter kickoff goes to the away team at its own 25.
- Fixed the final-score panel condition so a final touchdown conversion can still be selected.

### Active
- Validate and finish the card-game gameplay, including CPU offense and scoring/clock flow.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `card-game.js` for remaining gameplay bugs, particularly conversion/game-over handling and CPU possessions.
2. Run the game and verify it in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Run available checks and report assumptions and results.

## Relevant Files
- `card-game.js`: Card-game state, play resolution, scoring, CPU, and UI behavior.
- `card-game.css`: Card-game interface styling.
- `index.html`: Game shell and legacy implementation that the card-game script overrides.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- An attempted edit to `cpuOffense()` failed because the exact multiline match did not match; the two individual replacements succeeded, updating field-goal selection odds and CPU punt selection.
